cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.
